card.name: Word right after a drug name or subject
card.fires_on: The word that comes right after a drug or product name, or after a general noun such as patients or antibacterial drug, in label statements. Often it is a verb or form word such as should, is, oral, use or LIVE.

modes.label: After a drug name
modes.description: A form or verb word directly after a brand or generic drug name.
modes.example: lamivudine<< oral>> solution and zidovudine oral

modes.label: After a class or subject noun
modes.description: A linking or auxiliary word after patients or a drug-class noun.
modes.example: antibacterial. If this occurs, patients<< should>> contact their physician as soon as possible.

modes.label: End of a product name
modes.description: The last piece of a multi-part product name.
modes.example: PIASK<<Y>> is available only through a restricted program under
